title: Link batch
description: The body of one POST of the session to the events URL of its gateway's link, application/cloudevents-batch+json: events of one run, in the session's order, never empty. Each is an event of the contract without sequence, and none is an event the gateway writes: the gateway numbers the run's stream, registers the run as the node toward the server and writes dev.qory.run.registered for it, and writes the run's dev.qory.run.egress. A dev.qory.run.started is opened by the run, Forager's open; a dev.qory.run.exited is the close's, with timeout, interrupted and no_session as the only ones of Forager's reasons, since the gateway writes the event of every other reason itself, timeout and interrupted with the state cancelled and timeout with exit_code 124; a dev.qory.session.exited is the session's, a runtime's exit, with no reason, timeout or interrupted, or a refused join, failed with exit_code -1 and a code the session decides itself, since the gateway writes the dev.qory.session.exited of a session whose run it ends; and a dev.qory.run.refused has a code the session decides itself, those of refusal.Decides, and no name of the form <member>=<value>, which only a gateway's refusal carried under the reserved codes target_differs_from_credential and differs_from_credential. The gateway refuses a batch on rules the schema cannot state as well: the README's §The gateway's link lists them.

event.description: An event as event.schema.json defines it, with no sequence, and not dev.qory.run.registered or dev.qory.run.egress, which the gateway writes. A dev.qory.run.started has opened_by run, a dev.qory.run.exited's reason, when present, is timeout or interrupted, with the state cancelled, timeout with exit_code 124, or no_session, or none of Forager's other codes, run_closed and the old names among them, a dev.qory.session.exited's reason, when present, is timeout or interrupted, or a code the session decides itself with the state failed, and one with no reason has a signal or an exit_code other than -1, and a dev.qory.run.refused's code is one the session decides itself, with no name labels.<key>=<value> or about.details.<key>=<value>.
